policy.champion_scope: 每次运行必须覆盖全部 required=true 的竞品；任何缺跑均为 CHAMPION_NOT_PROVEN
policy.claim_boundary: sealed dataset + identities + versions + total budget + dimensions + repeats

competitors.name: gepa
competitors.fallback_mode: none; missing API or candidate blocks
competitors.evidence_rule: candidate must be independently rescored; missing finalist blocks when required

competitors.name: autoresearch
competitors.native_mode: verified official/controlled Git workspace + isolated real external command
competitors.version_basis: official karpathy/autoresearch workspace observed at runtime
competitors.evidence_rule: candidate must be independently rescored; missing finalist blocks when required

competitors.name: meta_harness

competitors.name: promptfoo
